description: Six stereo core frames, each with one invalid field: SHORT 5 in a normal frame, 20 blocks, 4 subframes for 16 blocks, 3 primary channels for 2/0, 33 active subbands, and a joint source that comes after its channel.

decode_errors.512: Unsupported number of PCM sample blocks (20)
decode_errors.1536: Invalid number of primary audio channels (3) for audio channel arrangement (2)

skip.ffprobe_packets: ffmpeg's parser takes a sync word as a frame only when the bits after it are those of a normal frame, FTYPE 1 and SHORT 31 (dca_parser.c, IS_CORE_MARKER), so it skips the first frame and reports the first packet at position 0
skip.decode: ffmpeg rejects five of the six frames, each with its own error (decode_errors), and accepts the joint source after its channel
skip.libdca: libdca reads the frames with 3 primary channels, 33 subbands and the others as it can; its reading of invalid fields says nothing
